findings.detail: Path-based temp creation and replace could follow a parent replaced after resolution. The write path now opens the workspace and parent descriptor-relative with O_NOFOLLOW and uses dir_fd for create, replace and cleanup. The regression failed first.

resolve() ran before the symlink check, so a symlinked store was reported as an escape rather than an unsafe entry. The lexical in-workspace check and symlink check now run before resolution; the regression covers no outside read/write.
retire accepted any --superseded-by string. It now refuses self-supersession and requires another record in the same store. The regression failed before the fix.
The CLI imported a private v2 reader. read_v2_store is now the explicit public reader used by the command path.

Missing --store on accept/retire/forget bypassed the JSON error envelope through argparse. The store is optional at parse time and the command layer returns the documented exit-2 JSON error. The regression failed first.
The v2 reader fell back to a path open when O_NOFOLLOW was unavailable. It now fails closed before reading. The regression failed with a misleading no-such-memory result before the fix.

Concurrent v2 mutations used stale snapshots and could resurrect a successfully forgotten record. A v2 lock now covers read-modify-write and returns busy on contention. The two-writer regression failed before the fix.
The v2 lock was opened by path with a+ and could follow a symlink. It now checks the entry and opens with O_NOFOLLOW. The regression failed before the fix.
accept changed the admission and timestamp fields but did not record the actor in the schema-supported updated_by field. It now writes the normalized approver. The regression failed before the fix.

The v2 reader has no direct descriptor-relative parent traversal yet; a replaced-parent read test only establishes fail-closed behavior before the file open. No recall or prompt injection was added.
